title: What’s next for Nvidia? Whatever doesn’t rock the mind-bogglingly profitable boat
description: If someone handed you $8,300 every second, what would you do? That's how much pure profit Nvidia now makes. By the time you finish reading this paragraph, Nvidia will likely have cleared $45,000 and change.
